record.issue_text: admin-group.js.es6 addMembers action has no .catch/error handling if the addMembers promise rejects

adjudication.rationale: In the diff, the `addMembers` action calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` and does not attach a `.catch` (nor does it `return` the promise). While that means this action doesn’t implement local error handling, this is not a clearly verifiable defect introduced by the change: the model method `Group#addMembers` returns the `Discourse.ajax(...)` promise and any rejection can be handled by Discourse/Ember’s global AJAX/promise error handling (a common pattern). The diff alone doesn’t show a requirement that this action must catch/recover from errors, so this is more of a robustness suggestion than a concrete bug.
